headline: Amazon's new Fire TV Stick 4K adds direct power and new remote
summary: Amazon unveiled a new, thinner and faster Fire TV Stick 4K that can draw power directly from a TV's USB port, no longer requiring a power adapter, and ships with a redesigned remote. It will cost $30 during Prime Day deals, or $60 at full retail price.
